source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: You may recover up to 3 models for the bearer’s unit in your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase). Use D3+3 instead if one of your objective markers is in that unit’s range. An **Attached unit** leaves its **CHARACTER** casualties **destroyed**. A returning model cannot reuse a **[[ONE SHOT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/one-shot)** weapon it fired earlier.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 7 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
